bestBets.overview: Sunny days leading in, the 'Sunshine Coast' track should be perfect. Rail in the true could see the winners coming down the crown. Time will tell. Kick things off with a 1000m Maiden Handicap. As things stand four of the nine will be on debut, (all have had at least one recent public trial). One other is 1st-up from a spell. The market moves as they make their way to the barriers demand more respect than would already be the case.The resuming MAGIC INVADER can be the one to beat. Placed six of ten, there's some decent form-lines in that, a 3rd to four times winner Point Vega and a 2nd to three times winner Zoustrology. Fitted for this with a recent trial win by almost four lengths. The stablemate FAWUNDERPAR has the benefit of recent racing, decent form-lines too. FLYING VENTO and SUBPOENA COLADA best of the debutantes? If 'they' come for 2 go along for the ride.

raceTips.comment: We race at the Sunshine Coast on Sunday where the track will be rated good & the weather perfect. Subpoena Colada gets the nod on debut in this opening race. Trials have been solid & this stable place their runners very well, follow any market support. Magic Invader has the race experience & placed 6 of 10 overall, recent trial win was a dominant one.

The stablemate OOHLALOUVRE ran on well fresh, she impressed when winning 2nd-up last time in, that was over 1000m at Eagle Farm. She's placed six of nine here. Not sure about the form of the resuming MERCATELLO, had two trials to prep, won the latter.  TASMAN BAY impressed fresh on this track over this distance on a soft 5. bestBets.overview: 1200m QTIS 3yo Maiden Hcp. As things stand six will be on debut, three will be 1st-up from a spell. That's a brutal first leg of a quaddy! All the newcomers have had at least one recent public trial, hence there is little to no guesswork in the opening set of prices. Heinrich & Rodgers are good for three of the fifteen starters, but the market sheds little light with this yard. Shaun Dwyer is good for two, both of his are on debut, hence you'd like to think their fluc's will be a guide to stable expectations.  The resuming EDDINGTON tips itself, having placed 2nd on debut to Martist which went on to place 3rd in the Sires Produce and 4th in the J J Atkins. SUMMER SENSATION ran well for 2nd when 1st-up at the Gold Coast. 2nd-up last time in ran well when 4th to Cherry Bomshell, the latter went on to win the Percy Sykes in Sydney at its next start. Risk either at your peril. EMBER ROYALE the best of the newcomers?

raceTips.comment: Kelly Schweida trained Summer Sensation gets the nod here. First 3 starts all in better company than this she resumed over 1000m at the Gold Coast running on well. The step to 1200m today looks ideal. Radomir halved his price first up ($20-$10) & ran well, caught deep he never shirked his task at any stage & draws much more favourably today. Sovereign Style another well backed on debut ran well, include.

bestBets.overview: 1000m Open Hcp. As things stand Sharryn Livingstone is good for three, Kendrick has a pair, as does Jack Bruce. So there's 63% of the remaining eleven from just the three yards. All eyes to the market from the get-go! No's 1,2,6,8,13 bickering and arguing over who leads who, pace should be on. Sets up well for something to emerge and with the rail in the true there's a decent chance that is not a problem at all. CHAKRA BOY fitter for the 1st-up 2nd, and is a proven conveyance at this track. MAXIMUM OUTPUT was flattered by the walk in the park up front last start. WONDEREACH resumes, all priors fresh in NSW and/or Vic. Alley gives Emily Lang suitable options. THELWELL has the map to suit and an obvious liking for this venue (Track: 13:4:2:1). And does partake off an easy win. KRAKARIB strips fitter, drops in class. SHAKO didn't get a fair go when 4th home 1st-up in town. If that aforementioned pace remains this should be getting its chance to not just be unimpeded but to be in the finish.

raceTips.comment: Get the feeling recent newcomer to the Jack Bruce yard Wondereach will prove very hard to beat fresh. He's won 2 of 6 when resuming in the past & his trial form has been very good, market of course will be our best guide though. Maximum Output clearly the horse to beat on form, huge odds last start when giving Steady Ready a run for his money, freshened up any repeat of that he wins, simple as that!

bestBets.overview: 1400m C1. No's 5,7,9,10 could be the forward runners. COMIN'HOMETOYOU might have used up all of its luck for the present time. A last start maiden winner at Doomben, both 2nd (the unfortunately named Moscow Mule) and 3rd St Andrews were unlucky and bold (respectively) in defeat. The map says M Rodd has a job on his hands from out there too. ADRANOS 'never wins' but is never far away. The fact Gollan hasn't moved it on already should be viewed positively. The lighter raced EL CENTRO is also invariably thereabouts and also that should yet again be the case. HOMERIC opted out of Ipswich on Friday, looked a great hope there, draws just as awkwardly today hence one can only assume the C & C Munce stable burnt the midnight oil aka did their form and preferred the look of this assignment. DIVINE JUSTICE is relatively new blood, fitter for the 1st-up 4th where she was easy in the betting. Include if support arrives.  EXCEED PERFECTION was well tried and unlucky new blood when 5th home 1st-up here over 1300m.The map looks ideal, for mine is the one to beat. VANZADEE is one for one here, may well have been a run short last start.

raceTips.comment: Open race where I'll lean to El Centro who has been in the placings all runs this time in. Just missed out at Ipswich last start, will handle the trip ok, gets Ben Thompson to steer & drops in weight. Poor draw for Adranos however should things pan out & he gets across he's a big chance. Cantarito next best, consistent without winning.

bestBets.overview: 1200m BM58. A no pace race on paper, no's 5 & 11 can be making the most of that.  As things stand Kendrick is good for two as is Trevor Thomas. I STOLE IT could redeem itself, reason being the state of the ground here compared to last start fail. BLUE ALLURE strips fitter again, once again the market is the best guide. COL BURN resumes, won on debut, was rushed to town then spelled. YES DONALD YES resumes, maps a treat. TOO DARN FINESSE is fit and well new blood, looks a must include. The resuming LADY WINDERMERE was a worthy winner when last seen fresh ($51.00-$31.00). All eyes to the betting in this get-out.

raceTips.comment: Col Burn the tip in the last resuming from a break. He's had 3 lead-up trials suggesting he'll be ready to fire first up & Ben Thompson to ride is a good lead. The Kendrick pair Limero (first up) & Spies On in the mix whilst I'm happy to taken on the resuming Run Donald Run who although winning by a space last start beat absolutely nothing & resumes here without a trial.
